MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The longer Ethernet cable would complement my recent five-foot cables by letting me reach devices farther apart.",
    "The RJ45 couplers would help me extend cables I already own, which fits my recent interest in wired connections and cable organization."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The USB-C Ethernet adapter serves a similar purpose to my recent USB-A adapter, but I have no established need for another connector type.",
    "The iMac memory and keyboard cover require specific hardware compatibility that my history does not establish.",
    "The desktop case assumes a new build, while my recent purchases suggest maintaining and organizing an existing setup.",
    "The camera, portable speaker, and protection plans do not address a current need shown by my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been taken as interest in almost any computer component, even when it requires a different project or device.",
    "My headphone purchases seem to have been treated as broader interest in audio equipment, although a portable speaker serves a different purpose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Ethernet adapter and cables make accessories that extend those connections more useful than another adapter with unconfirmed compatibility.",
    "My cable organizers, headphone mount, and duster suggest practical improvements to my existing workspace.",
    "My keyboard dampeners suggest that typing feel matters to me, so a cover is only appealing if it fits and preserves that feel."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my networking needs but stretched my interest in practical setup improvements into unrelated equipment and unsupported upgrades."
}
